# North

North reimagines the gaming PC, introducing natural materials and bespoke details to make gaming a stylish addition to your living space. Leveraging design to give you a better experience, its airflow functionality and intuitive layout make building and gaming both smooth and enjoyable.

North

Type

North Charcoal Black

## Natural design

Enhance the look of your gaming station with a real walnut front and sleek brass details.

## Gaming ready

Choose a GPU up to 355 mm, or up to 300 mm with a 360 mm front radiator.

## Easy access

Remove the side panels, unclip the front and pop off the top panel using an integrated tab.

## Type-C interface

Three front USB ports including one USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 Type-C with speeds up to 20 Gbps

## Ventilated performance

Enjoy natural ventilation through an open front and stylishly integrated mesh panels.

## Naturally unique

Enjoy a unique finish, with front panel bars cut from sustainably sourced oak or walnut

## Build versatility

Make the most of your building experience with an intuitive interior layout.

## Flexible storage

North features two included combined 3.5″/2.5″ drive mounts and two dedicated 2.5″ drive mounts out of the box

# Meshify 2

The new Meshify 2 is a classic evolved with focus on distinctive design, spacious interior and rugged good looks.

Type

Meshify 2 Black

## A classic evolved

## Detachable front filter

The new front nylon filter can easily be removed from the hinged mesh panel for increased airflow.

## Superlative storage

Convert to Storage Layout and install up to 11 HDDs alongside four dedicated SSDs mounts. (6x SSD/HDD trays, 2x SSD brackets and 1x Multibracket included)

## Extremely flexible

Transformable interior design utilizing a movable wall for enhancing custom builds.

## Type-C interface

Front I/O offers easy access to ports, including one USB Type-C with speeds up to 20 Gbps.

## Smooth airflow

Three Dynamic X2 GP-14 fans come preinstalled with room to expand up to a total of nine fans.

## Versatile multibracket

The included Multibracket lets you convert any unused fan position to an HDD, SSD or pump mount.

## Two-year warranty

Rest assured with a two-year warranty covering all of our cases, backed by our dedicated customer support team whenever you need assistance.
